_purpose: Metadata for evaluation/annotation/pass1_relationships.json (one of two independent LLM-derived annotation passes over rc2_rc3_relationships_blind.json). RECTIFIED (external "reality check" review round 3, P0-10/P1 annotation metadata) -- this file did not exist before this pass; most fields below are genuinely unrecoverable from the project's existing records and are disclosed as null rather than guessed, per protocol.md v2.0's explicit instruction to do so.
model_name_note: Not recorded at annotation time. paper/sections/annotation_protocol.tex discloses only that this is an 'LLM-derived reference annotation', without naming the specific model -- this metadata gap is itself the reason protocol.md v2.0 now requires model_name to be recorded going forward.
prompt_hash_note: The prompt given to the annotator was protocol.md's Task 2 instructions plus rc2_rc3_relationships_blind.json as the item list; no hash of the exact prompt text sent was captured at the time.
sample_seed_note: See rc2_rc3_relationships.meta.json -- this pass judged that same fixed sample, not a separately-drawn one.
annotation_timestamp_note: Not recorded precisely; this round is documented as occurring after the bidirectional-NLI rewrite described in paper/sections/system.tex, using SMRITI output from run 20260910_124212.
blind_status_note: This pass had no access to SMRITI's own predicted labels (rc2_rc3_relationships_blind.json carries no prediction fields) and no access to the other pass's output (independent, no shared context, per protocol.md).
